name: The Witness
fieldReading: What you carry home is the only copy.
bio: Stands a half-step outside so that everyone else can disappear into it. Gives the night back to them later, when they need to know it was real.
sceneStory: At the rim of a canyon overlooking a valley flooded with glowing light, a figure raises both hands and draws them slowly upward. The whole scene below lifts and spools into a long ribbon of light that winds up and coils around them.
assignments: The world lets go; you keep the thread,
and by that thread they find the way back.
tagline: Go lose yourselves — I'm holding the thread
